title: seaborn: distributions, relationships and categories in one line

videos.script: In matplotlib, a histogram for each plan is a loop, a call per plan and a legend built by hand. {{loop}} In seaborn it is one line. Give it the table, name the column, and name the column that splits it. {{one}} That works because the table is long, one trip per row. Lesson fifteen was for this. {{long}} This lesson draws the three kinds of question every data set gets. {{three}} How a column is spread. How two columns move together. How groups compare. {{kinds}} And it reads what seaborn decides for you. A bar plot draws means, not counts. Its error bars come from random samples, and change every run unless you give them a seed. {{decides}} One line draws the chart. Knowing what that line computed is the rest of the job. {{end}}
